turns.line: Good evening. I've been expecting you. Please... sit. Before we begin, tell me your name.
turns.label: What is your name?

turns.line: Mm. Breathe slowly. Now — when the lights go out and the house goes quiet... what do you see?
turns.label: What do you see in the dark?

turns.line: One last question. Answer carefully — what you tell me next becomes the world you wake up in. What is your greatest fear?
turns.label: What is your greatest fear?
